english.title: Cause use of vehicle with all warning beacons fitted not working

additionalkeywords.additionalkeyword: SPEED NOT EXCEEDING 25 MILES PER HOUR

english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..) caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use on an unrestricted dual carriageway road, namely **(..SPECIFY DUAL CARRIAGEWAY ROAD..), a vehicle, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), when not every warning beacon required to be fitted by regulation 17 of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989 was kept lit.
english.legislation: Contrary to regulation 26of the Road Vehicles Lighting Regulations 1989, section 42 of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
english.pointstoprove:
date and location
cause use of a vehicle on unrestricted dual carriageway road
not every warning beacon kept lit

english.notes:
(i) This offence wording relates to the use of obligatory amber warning beacons on vehicles. For the misuse of optional warning beacons see H3093 in relation to flashing lamps/beacons and H273, H299 and H300 in relation to coloured lamps/reflectors/beacons other than red showing to the rear of the vehicle.
(ii) See regulation 17(2) for exceptions.
(iii) Statement of Facts procedure applies - see end of document for wording.
(iv) See also offence wordings: H3097 and H3099.
english.standardstatementoffacts: At **(..SPECIFY TIME..) on **(..SPECIFY DATE..) the defendant caused **(..SPECIFY PERSON..) to use **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..) on **(..SPECIFY ROAD AND LOCATION..) when **(..SPECIFY WARNING BEACON..) was not kept lit.

other.penalty:
A fine not exceeding level three on the standard scale (level four if goods vehicle or vehicle adapted to carry more than eight passengers).

Time limit for prosecutions:
6 months
